limitations: Rendered event rows only; U is WCL's unmitigated estimate. Null fields were not printed in the row.

fully_absorbed_note: Rows with no displayed amount (fully absorbed) carry a WCL-estimated U (absorbed / (1 - mitigation estimate)). They are kept, but they are less direct: two such Onyxia rows in different kills both read U 42,883 (MxFq7 00:28.770 A 11,823 M 72.43%; farY2 00:33.395 A 12,982 M 69.73%), and they set Onyxia's upper bound. Fully absorbed rows skew low and rows with an amount skew high, so the sample means sit near or above the extreme-value bounds (mean_implied_effective_multiplier).
